mapper.select:
SELECT n.id, n.type, n.title, n.content, (r.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS read, n.created_at FROM blog_notification_recipient r INNER JOIN blog_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND n.type IN ('COMMENT_REPLY', 'MESSAGE_REPLY')
AND n.type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE'
AND n.type = #{type}
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL AND n.type IN ('COMMENT_REPLY', 'MESSAGE_REPLY')) AS reply, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL AND n.type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE') AS admin_message FROM blog_notification_recipient r INNER JOIN blog_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update:
UPDATE blog_notification_recipient r SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) FROM blog_notification n WHERE r.notification_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.read_at IS NULL AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND n.type IN ('COMMENT_REPLY', 'MESSAGE_REPLY')
AND n.type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_notification WHERE type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_notification ( type, target_scope, title, content, status, source_type, source_id, created_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{type}, #{targetScope}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{createdBy}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO blog_notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id) SELECT #{notificationId}, id FROM blog_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_notification WHERE id = #{notificationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_notification SET target_scope = #{targetScope}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE' AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE blog_notification SET status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, offline_at = #{offlineAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE'
